verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents an MCP server for coding agents with OAuth 2.1 authentication and tools to list services and run SQL (docs-7). It also exposes the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface so any CLI or driver works unchanged (docs-5), and CHKit offers agent-drivable typed commands to describe schemas (docs-11). Governance is covered by table/column-scoped roles, full query logging, and isolated read-only agent compute (docs-24, docs-14, docs-12). Missing for 10: an explicitly documented schema/table-discovery tool in the MCP surface (beyond listing services), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the end-to-end agent flow works as claimed.
